scan_id.description: The scan to report; absent lists the scans.

shape.description: summary (default): index, bands, per-language means, finding counts and the worst files; findings: the records page by page.

worst.description: summary: how many worst files to list (default 10).

cursor.description: findings: where to continue (next_cursor of the previous page).

min_severity.description: findings: leave out findings below this severity.

path.description: findings: a glob over the file paths.
